claim: Fix an integer \(n\ge4\). In the single-excitation XY model of Casaccino--Lloyd--Mancini--Severini on the complete graph \(K_n\), all off-diagonal couplings have Hamiltonian weight \(2\), and the two designated input/output vertices receive the same positive energy shift \(\Delta>0\). Put \[\alpha(\Delta)=\sqrt{4n^2-4(n-4)\Delta+\Delta^2},\qquad \beta(\Delta)=\frac{\Delta-2n}{\alpha(\Delta)}.\]Then perfect state transfer between the shifted vertices occurs if and only if \(\beta(\Delta)=p/q\) in lowest terms for integers \(q>0\), \(|p|<q\), with \(p\) and \(q\) of opposite parity. In that case all positive perfect-transfer times are exactly \[t=\frac{2\pi q}{\alpha(\Delta)}(2s+1),\qquad s=0,1,2,\ldots.\]Equivalently, all positive perfect-transfer shifts are \[\Delta_{p,q}=\frac{\left(2p+\sqrt{2nq^2-2(n-2)p^2}\right)^2}{q^2-p^2},\]with the same coprimality, size, and opposite-parity conditions. This set is countable and dense in \((0,\infty)\). The source's tuning \(\Delta=2n\) is exactly the case \((p,q)=(0,1)\), not the only positive shift producing exact transfer.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; finite reduced-dynamics checks are supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Complete fixed-coupling necessary-and-sufficient classification, exact transfer-time set, explicit shift parametrization, and density statement.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The complete-graph spectrum, transition amplitudes, and the particular shift Delta=2n are credited to Casaccino et al.; general weighted-join and graph-potential existence results are credited separately.

scientific_limitations: The classification is for n>=4, positive equal shifts on exactly two marked vertices, and fixed off-diagonal XY weight 2.
Unequal potentials, altered edge weights, noisy Hamiltonians, missing-edge graphs, and pretty-good transfer are outside the theorem.
Density concerns exact parameter values and does not imply robustness or uniformly short transfer times.
An equivalent specialization may exist in later graph-potential literature under different notation.
title: A dense arithmetic spectrum of perfect-transfer energy shifts on complete spin networks
